q: Can I still start at 50 or older?
a: Yes. People 50 and older can save extra each year in retirement accounts. Paying off debt and choosing when to start Social Security also make a big difference.

q: I have credit card debt. Should I invest?
a: Usually not yet. Debt over 15% APR grows faster than investments usually do. Build a $1,000 cushion, get any job match, then pay the debt down.

q: How much money do I need to start?
a: Very little. $5 a week is a real start. Many funds let you start with small amounts.

q: What if the market drops after I invest?
a: Drops are normal. Selling during a drop locks in the loss. Only invest money you won't need for 5 years or more, and try the practice page first.

q: I don't have a bank account. Where do I start?
a: Look for a free account at an FDIC-insured bank or NCUA-insured credit union with no overdraft fees. The Banking topic above can help.
